unresolved: Annex F (FoodEx2 level-by-level summary statistics) is not in the PDF; only Tables 8-11 are extracted.
Table 9 rows derived from rice or marine fish via processing factors (rice porridge, rice drink, rice pudding, fish balls etc.) are modelled values, not measurements, and were not extracted.
Table 8/9 percentile columns (HRP) give the 'highest reliable percentile' with varying percentile level and were not extracted except the P95 values where the table column is P95.
Table 11 rows from Leblanc (2006), Hackethal et al. (2021), Zmozinski et al. (2015) are literature data and were not extracted as EFSA occurrence.
Reporting basis: whole weight per the opinion, but dried algae (Table 9) are on a different basis; basis recorded unknown.
Table 8 meat and milk P95 values (0.0 / 20.0) are fully left-censored and were not extracted as percentiles.
